title.en: Two timber barrels with metal hoops

alt.tr: Üst üste konmuş, metal çemberli iki büyük ahşap varil; arkada başka fıçılar
alt.en: Two large timber barrels with metal hoops placed one on top of the other, with more casks behind

caption.tr: Alttaki varil geniş ve yatık, üsttekini ahşap iki ayak tutuyor. Çemberler koyu metalden.
caption.en: The lower barrel is wide and lying and two wooden feet hold the upper one. The hoops are dark metal.
